$comment: The installers' answers contract. Every question quickstart.sh, setup.sh and install/install-native.sh ask, with the variable that answers it in advance, its rule and default. The website's install wizard reads this file at the release tag; tests/installer-answers/run.sh (CI) fails when it and the scripts disagree. Rules are install/lib/answers.sh's (the scripts are authoritative); regex is the same rule for a browser, an ERE that is also a JavaScript RegExp, applied to a non-empty value.

answersFile.description: An absolute path to a file of KEY=VALUE lines (any answer or setting below, by its env name; # comments and blank lines allowed; one pair of surrounding quotes is removed; never sourced). The environment wins over the file. Unknown or repeated keys stop the installer, and so does any file that does not belong to the user running the installer (or root) with no access for anyone else (chmod 600): it chooses what is installed and may hold the tunnel token.

forwards.description: With --native, setup.sh hands its other arguments to install/install-native.sh, which takes these.

settings.description: 1: never ask. A missing answer with a default takes it; a missing answer without one stops the installer, naming its variable.
1: check the answers, print the plan (each question: its answer, default, or ?/ask) and exit, before anything on the host is checked or changed. Needs no root, Docker or network.
The directory the quick start installs into (created; relative to the current directory).
The release to install (X.Y.Z, 0.4.0 or later). Default: the latest published release of the repo.
A fork's release signing key: the key line (line 2) of its release/minisign.pub.

options.description: How the server is reached: tunnel (Cloudflare Tunnel, no open ports), domain (your own domain, ports 80/443, a Let's Encrypt certificate from Caddy), or host-nginx (an existing Nginx on the host reverse-proxies to the Docker backend).
The GitHub repository whose releases are installed (owner/name).
The GHCR owner of the release's images, in lowercase.
The public hostname devices use (the name only: no https://, path or user@), optionally with :port. The base URL becomes https://<host>. In domain mode its DNS must point at this server.

options.description: The Cloudflare Tunnel token (Zero Trust → Networks → Tunnels → your tunnel). A secret: answer the question, or put it in an answers file (which must belong to the user running the installer, with mode 600); never on a command line or in export, where shell history and the process list show it. The installers never print it or pass it to another program.
